title: Midnight Rivière Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Deep blue, after dark. A tennis bracelet of round brilliant cut navy blue cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own gold four claw cup and linked edge to edge, so the line reads dark and rich against warm gold. A slim fold over clasp closes it. The stones are blue cubic zirconia rather than sapphire. Wear it with black for evening, or with an ivory saree for a festive night.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with black and one pair of small gold studs.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut navy blue cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
  • Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Stone note: Blue cubic zirconia, not sapphire
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
